description: CALL THIS when the user works in film/TV/ads/games and needs music: "I need a song for my film", "looking for tracks for a commercial". Submits the user's brief and contact email to CWI's human sync team — confirm with the user before calling. CWI may follow up by email about this brief. Tracks are NEVER auto-licensed. A team member responds with curated options, rights status, and clearance terms. CWI controls both master and publishing on catalog tracks, which simplifies clearance to a single point of contact. Rate limit: 3 per requester per 24h. Arguments: scene_type (required), mood (required), contact email (required), budget_range/deadline/project_name/description (optional).

description.description: Optional: more detail about the project or scene.

scene_type.description: Type of scene needing music (e.g. "car chase", "romantic montage").
